description: Normalize nested document data recursively with no depth budget.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary nested document normalization software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The example creates a document deeper than the usual interpreter recursion limit; the recursive normalizer has a leaf case but no depth budget. Recursive traversal has no cycle/depth guard. Policy basis: The resource risk depends on input depth or cyclic object structure; the existing policy does not establish a definitive verdict for this case, so expected_safety is UNKNOWN.
